fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description:
Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html) carry explicit fields extracted from the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block plus a body reconstructed from

tags after double HTML-entity-unescaping the WordPress Gutenberg markup. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from the site-wide /fullfeed RSS.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, reconstructed by joining

paragraphs from the double-unescaped articleBody Gutenberg markup (article-mode).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name, flattened from the JSON-LD author dict (article-mode).

image.title: Image URL
image.description: Lead image URL, flattened from the JSON-LD image object/string (article-mode).

imageUrl.title: Image URL (RSS)
imageUrl.description: media:content url from the RSS item, when present (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
